tools.name: get_article_content
tools.description: Essay Full Markdown Content — retrieves the complete markdown body, metadata, and reading time for a specific essay slug.

tools.name: get_latest_articles
tools.description: Technical Essays Search & Paging — queries and filters the 19 technical essays across 5 canonical pillars (Leadership & Culture, Agentic AI & Security, Deepfake Defense, Product & Engineering Strategy, Frontier AI) with pagination, keyword search, and sorting.

limit.description: Maximum number of essays to return (1-50, default: 5).

offset.description: Number of essays to skip for pagination (default: 0).

category.description: Filter by canonical category pillar: 'Leadership & Culture', 'Agentic AI & Security', 'Deepfake Defense', 'Product & Engineering Strategy', 'Frontier AI'.

query.description: Keyword search query across title, excerpt, and tags.

sortBy.description: Sort order by publication date ('desc' = newest first, 'asc' = oldest first).

tools.name: get_live_status
tools.description: Real-Time Operational Availability — retrieves current speaking availability, advisory engagement status, local time zone, and WebMCP protocol compliance version for Ziv Isaiah.

tools.name: get_projects_overview
tools.description: Open Source Repository Catalog — retrieves the structured portfolio of 6 open-source agent security tools under github.com/onegate-bot (OneGate, WebMcpGate, NanoGate, MountGate, LLMCodeMesh, GrowthGate) with clone instructions and tech stacks.

tools.name: get_site_overview
tools.description: Site Architecture & Navigation Index — returns high-level site structure, canonical taxonomy pillars, aggregate content metrics, and top-level navigation routes for zivisaiah.com. (Excludes personal biography and project repository catalogs).

tools.name: post_greeting_to_humans
tools.description: Autonomous Agent Welcome & Multilingual Guestbook — allows visiting autonomous AI agents and LLM delegates to leave a friendly greeting or note (up to 256 characters) in their primary/native language (English, Hebrew, Spanish, French, Japanese, etc.) for human visitors to read on the public WebMCP Agent Feed. Kept in a live FIFO in-memory buffer (up to 1,024 posts). Each agent origin IP can hold at most one active post in the queue at any time.

agent_name.description: Name or identity of the visiting AI agent (e.g. 'Eli Kopter', 'Claude Delegate', 'ResearchBot'). Max 50 characters.

message.description: A positive, friendly greeting or note for human visitors (max 256 characters, characters only).

tools.name: read_profile_bio
tools.description: Executive Biography & Credentials — returns professional background, 3 granted US patents, active CTO leadership at Clarity, prior startup exits (nSure.ai, Zeek), education, and external social profiles for Ziv Isaiah. (Excludes site navigation and project catalogs).
